page_title: ALA 1-0 RSO | Alaves v Real Sociedad 23/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Mateo Busquets is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Today's referee Mateo Busquets rightly decides to book Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) for his harsh tackle.
90+4' Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+2' Mateo Busquets shows the yellow card to Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) for a heavy challenge.
90+2' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Mateo Busquets didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+1' The main referee, Mateo Busquets, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+1' The expression of the referee Mateo Busquets is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Antonio Sivera (Alaves) is shown a yellow card.
90+1' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Real Sociedad players look gutted.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Real Sociedad score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
90' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) has a goal ruled out for offside!
88' Alex Remiro displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Toni Martinez (Alaves) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
87' Poor challenge! Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) is penalised for tripping and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle.
86' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes.
85' 36:64 – the ratio of ball possession.

82' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) was all set to celebrate a sensational goal after he collected a rebound and blasted a shot in from long range. Unfortunately for him, his effort crashed against the crossbar. What an unlucky moment for him.
82' The free kick is delivered by Carlos Vicente (Alaves) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
82' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. A free kick to Alaves.
80' The foul by Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Mateo Busquets.
79' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
78' Toni Martinez (Alaves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kike Garcia.
76' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Sergio Gomez will be replaced by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad).
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad) is replacing Pablo Marin.
76' The corner is floated into the centre of the box, but a placed header from Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) flies well wide of the right post.
76' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) prepares to take a corner kick.
76' Real Sociedad are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

74' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Mateo Busquets blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
73' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

73' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Alaves.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) comes onto the pitch for Jon Guridi.
71' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
70' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Alaves.
69' Real Sociedad are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
68' Kike Garcia (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
67' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) was too forceful with his tackle and Mateo Busquets interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
66' Substitution. Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) on for Brais Mendez.
65' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Jon Aramburu is replaced by Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad).
65' Substitution. Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) replaces Takefusa Kubo.

65' 1 - 0 The ball hits the back of the net! Carlos Vicente delivers the corner, Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) finds himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes an unstoppable shot which goes inside the right post and past the helpless goalkeeper. 1:0.
64' There's an opportunity for Carlos Vicente (Alaves) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

64' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
64' Real Sociedad are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The linesman makes the right call and Real Sociedad will have a corner.
63' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
63' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is penalised for holding. Mateo Busquets signals a set piece.
62' Jon Guridi (Alaves) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
61' The corner from Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is cleared away by the defence.
61' The ball is cleared after Carlos Vicente (Alaves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Alaves force their opponents to concede a corner.
60' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
60' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches wide of the left post.
59' It seemed like Carlos Vicente (Alaves) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

59' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Alaves earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
55' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
54' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
54' The ball possession is 41:59.
52' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alex Remiro is well positioned and punches the ball away.
52' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Alaves have a corner.
50' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
49' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
48' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The linesman signals a throw-in for Alaves.
47' A yellow card for a tackle by Tomas Conechny (Alaves). Mateo Busquets doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
47' The attendance for today's match is 17049.
46' The game is over for Carlos Martin. Tomas Conechny (Alaves) comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Eduardo Coudet decided to make a change. Joan Jordan is replaced by Ander Guevara (Alaves).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
44' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) spurns a great opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. The ball flies narrowly wide of the left post.
44' Dangerous play by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad). Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
41' Flag goes up against Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
40' Carlos Martin (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Mateo Busquets blows for a foul.
39' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
39' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

39' The game is pretty dull as Alaves are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. Alaves win a corner.
38' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle and it's Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
38' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
38' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.

37' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Sociedad.
36' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
36' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
36' Mateo Busquets interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Antonio Blanco (Alaves).
34' Kike Garcia (Alaves) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
34' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
30' The referee shows the yellow card to Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad).
28' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
28' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
27' The current number of shots on goal is 0:0.
24' Mateo Busquets blows for a foul after Kike Garcia (Alaves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
24' Mateo Busquets couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) and blew his whistle.
22' Kike Garcia (Alaves) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
21' A dangerous towering header by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
21' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) steps up to send the ball in.

20' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
19' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) controls a great pass from Sergio Gomez on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
18' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
17' Real Sociedad keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Carlos Martin (Alaves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
14' The possession of the ball – 34:66.
12' Great teamplay by Real Sociedad as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
10' Carlos Martin (Alaves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
8' The referee blows his whistle as Antonio Blanco (Alaves) was too aggressive in his challenge.
7' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) commits a rough foul. Mateo Busquets stops the game and makes a call.
5' Neat passing move from Real Sociedad in order to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Jon Guridi (Alaves) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mateo Busquets blows for a foul.
3' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
2' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Alaves will have the kick-off.
